# Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics

On-demand production connectivity diagnostics for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Runs DNS, gateway, TCP, TLS, HTTPS, API health, latency, and packet-timing checks. Not another network monitor.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-network-diagnostics
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics

Registration: `UseNetworkDiagnostics` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- Why can the MAUI app see the internet but not the API?
- How do I run DNS / TCP / TLS / HTTPS diagnostics in MAUI?
- Production connectivity troubleshooting / support report
- `await NetworkDiagnostics.RunAsync()` instead of “Something went wrong.”
- Layered check: Internet, DNS, Gateway, TCP, TLS, HTTPS, API, Latency

## Do not use when

- The app only needs live reachability or captive-portal detection (use Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor)
- MAUI `Connectivity.NetworkAccess` is enough
- The need is HttpClient retry / circuit breaker (use Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience)
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a required target
